arxiv-2404-02069.title: Multivariate Bernstein-type Polynomials of Finitely Generated D D -Modules
arxiv-2404-02069.creator: Alexander Levin
arxiv-2404-02069.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alexander Levin. We generalize the Gröbner basis method for free D D -modules to the case of several term orderings induced by a partition of the set of basic variables. Using this generalized Gröbner basis technique we prove the existence and give a method of computation of a dimension polynomial in several variables associated with a finitely generated D D -module. We show that this dimension polynomial carries more invariants of a D D -module than the classical (univariate) Bernstein polynomial.
